reason: This plugin is primarily a DeepSeek Harness model-health utility that probes advertised models, tracks Alive/Dead status with retries, and shows the results in the DSH web UI model selectors and settings workflow. The README explicitly describes persistent host-side health state, scheduled rechecks every 30 minutes, runtime failure-based verification, and UI badges/filtering, which aligns to monitoring/automation for operational model reliability.

summaries.zh: DSH Model Probe 是一个 DeepSeek Harness 插件，用于持续探测已注册模型的健康状态并在 Web UI 中展示存活/故障状态和可用性相关操作。
summaries.en: DSH Model Probe is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that continuously monitors configured models and surfaces alive/dead health status directly in the DSH web UI.

capabilities: Monitors model availability (Alive/Dead) for provider-model pairs used by DeepSeek Harness
Runs manual and scheduled health probes with retry and recovery behavior
Persists health state and recent outcomes on the host filesystem
Injects health indicators and filtering behavior into DSH model selection UI

reasons.code: Plugin performs networked probe calls to validate model responsiveness and can trigger repeated requests during failures.
Health state and bounded history are stored in host state.json, which introduces local persistence and configurable file-path behavior.
Plugin is packaged as a DSH web plugin with client-side integration points (settings, model pickers, theme-aware UI), confirming UI/runtime-side impact.
